_comment: Real `docker compose` output for a stack whose app and app-migrate share a local-only image and depend on db. `config --images <svc>` prints the images of the service's dependencies too. Regenerate: run the compose file below through `docker compose config --format json` and `config --images <svc>` for each service.
compose:
name: demo
services:
  app:
    image: ${APP_IMAGE:-demo-app:local}
    pull_policy: never
    depends_on:
      app-migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
  app-migrate:
    image: ${APP_IMAGE:-demo-app:local}
    pull_policy: never
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
  db:
    image: ghcr.io/hyperformant/postgres:17
  traefik:
    image: ghcr.io/hyperformant/traefik:v3
    depends_on:
      - app
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11
    depends_on:
      - db
      - loki
  loki:
    image: grafana/loki:3
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:1
    depends_on:
      - db
  n8n-setup:
    image: n8nio/n8n:1
    depends_on:
      - n8n
